title: The Stainless Sky
summary: A calm, purifying sign. Conditions are clear and protected, but progress may be steady rather than fast.

interpretation.general: This is a sign of purification, balance, and removal of obstacles. Your situation is fundamentally safe and supported.
interpretation.caution: Friends, wealth, or resources may not stay with you unless you care for them intentionally. Some outcomes unfold slowly.

title: The Flaming Rays of the Sun
summary: A bright, clarifying sign. Doubt lifts, understanding sharpens, and matters become easier to resolve.

interpretation.general: This reading favors clarity, discernment, and forward movement. Good results are likely when you act with confidence and virtue.
interpretation.caution: Projects tied to land, houses, or heavy physical structures may need extra care.

title: The Nectar Rays of the Moon
summary: A gentle, nourishing sign. Peaceful and supportive actions prosper, especially those requiring care rather than force.

interpretation.general: This is a soft but auspicious reading. It supports healing, kindness, domestic harmony, and gradual increase.
interpretation.caution: Forceful, aggressive, or fire-related efforts are less favored.

title: The Bright Star
summary: A promising sign for movement, travel, giving, and action taken with steadiness and attention.

interpretation.general: Good results are available if you stay focused and do not let the mind scatter. Momentum is available, but it must be guided.
interpretation.caution: Agitation, mental restlessness, and water-related activities may create minor complications.

title: The Ground of Gold
summary: A stable, grounded sign. Long-term foundations are strong, though progress may take time.

interpretation.general: This reading supports steady work, remaining rooted, and building something durable. The future is solid if you are patient.
interpretation.caution: Results may come slowly. Communication-heavy or air-like activities may be less reliable.

title: The Tone of the Vajra
summary: A bright sign for intelligence, learning, artistry, and the fulfillment of thoughtful intentions.

interpretation.general: This is a refined, auspicious reading that supports study, creativity, scholarship, and clear-minded accomplishment.
interpretation.caution: Do not be distracted by appearances of trouble when the deeper movement is actually favorable.

title: The Bright Lamp
summary: A sign of clarity and self-reliance. Plans can succeed, though illness or fatigue may temporarily worsen.

interpretation.general: Your mind is capable of seeing clearly now. Obstacles are limited, and direct effort can bring success.
interpretation.caution: Health needs attention. Trouble may come from past causes rather than current hostility.

title: Adding Butter to the Burning Flames
summary: A fiery, energizing sign. Power, attraction, momentum, and rapid accomplishment are amplified.

interpretation.general: This reading brings force, charisma, and quick movement. It strongly favors decisive action and influence.
interpretation.caution: Large plans can become messy if they are poorly designed. Earth and water matters are less favored.

title: The Demon of Death
summary: A difficult sign of obstruction, decline, and vulnerability. This is not a time to force outcomes.

interpretation.general: Plans are easily extinguished under this reading. Delays, losses, or danger may arise if you push ahead carelessly.
interpretation.caution: Major efforts, travel, illness, and conflict all require caution. This is one of the more severe warnings.

title: The King of Power
summary: A commanding sign of strength, victory, and decisive impact. You have force behind you.

interpretation.general: This reading favors courageous action, overcoming opposition, and bringing strong intentions into form.
interpretation.caution: Use power wisely. Intensity is high, and overreach or aggression can become excessive.

title: The Dried-Up Tree
summary: A weak sign. Effort may not bear fruit, and enthusiasm may fade before results arrive.

interpretation.general: This reading suggests limited yield. What is attempted may dry out or lose momentum before completion.
interpretation.caution: Do not expect quick gains in wealth, support, or major ambitions.

title: The Door of Auspicious Visions
summary: A good sign of guidance, insight, and beneficial openings. Success comes through good counsel and wise alignment.

interpretation.general: This reading supports growth through vision, instruction, and spiritual or intuitive clarity.
interpretation.caution: Success improves when you listen to trustworthy advice rather than acting impulsively.

title: The Vase of Nectar
summary: A soothing and beneficial sign. Peaceful aims, healing, and support from others are strongly favored.

interpretation.general: This is a nourishing, restorative reading. Blessings come through receptivity, peace, and alignment with what is wholesome.
interpretation.caution: Even when successful, outcomes may feel quieter or less dramatic than expected.

title: The Pool Without a Source of Water
summary: A sign of depletion. Something may appear workable for now, but its source of support is weak.

interpretation.general: This reading warns of decline through lack of true nourishment or continuity. Gains may not last.
interpretation.caution: Wealth, energy, and plans may drain away unless renewed at the source.

title: The Ocean of Nectar
summary: A rich and abundant sign. Prosperity, nourishment, harmony, and ease of accomplishment are favored.

interpretation.general: This reading points to fullness, support, and smooth progress. Resources and cooperation tend to increase.
interpretation.caution: Water-related imbalances or excessive attachment may need attention. Fire-related commitments may be less ideal.

title: The Demon of Afflictions
summary: A troubled sign of agitation, conflict, and emotional or energetic disturbance.

interpretation.general: This reading indicates unrest. Plans may be undermined by anxiety, conflict, hidden opposition, or disruptive conditions.
interpretation.caution: Conflict, legal trouble, travel mishaps, and stress-related illness are more likely under this sign.

title: The Golden Lotus
summary: A beautiful sign of ripening, increase, and beneficial results that grow steadily over time.

interpretation.general: This reading supports prosperity, influence, generosity, and the gradual maturation of good conditions.
interpretation.caution: Progress may be slightly slower than desired even when the direction is clearly good.

title: The Nectar-Like Medicine
summary: A healing and fortunate sign. Plans align well, support is present, and remedies are effective.

interpretation.general: This reading suggests strong benefit, nourishment, and fulfillment. What you are trying to do can succeed in the form you envision.
interpretation.caution: Success is strongest when you follow good advice rather than improvising carelessly.

title: The White Umbrella of Good Fortune
summary: A sign of blessing and uplift, with good news and support, though not every promise fully materializes.

interpretation.general: Fortune rises here, and protection is present. The reading is supportive, especially for encouragement and renewal.
interpretation.caution: Not every plan becomes concrete. Promises or intentions may lack follow-through.

title: The Great Fiery Weapon
summary: A victorious sign for decisive action, forceful effort, and overcoming opposition.

interpretation.general: This reading favors triumph, strength, and the successful completion of difficult undertakings.
interpretation.caution: Use force with compassion and restraint. This energy is potent and should not become harsh for its own sake.

title: Empty of Intelligence
summary: A sign of confusion, dissipation, and plans slipping through your hands.

interpretation.general: This reading suggests that worry, distraction, or poor containment are undermining your efforts.
interpretation.caution: Money, support, and focus may leak away. Avoid pursuing unstable ideas or hostile relationships.

title: The Streamer of Fame
summary: A sign of recognition, renown, and visible success. Your name or work can travel widely now.

interpretation.general: This reading supports success that becomes known publicly. Influence and reputation can increase.
interpretation.caution: Excess can undermine itself. Large ambitions may need to be broken into smaller, manageable wins.

title: The Mara Demon of the Aggregates
summary: A heavy warning sign. Core areas of life may feel cut down, obstructed, or destabilized.

interpretation.general: This reading signals serious obstruction, depletion, or pressure on foundational matters.
interpretation.caution: Family, wealth, health, and luck may all be strained. This is a time for humility and remedial action, not force.

title: The House of Good Tidings
summary: A fast-moving, auspicious sign. Good news, swift success, and helpful connections are favored.

interpretation.general: This reading supports positive developments that arrive quickly. Communication and relationships are especially blessed.
interpretation.caution: Take advantage of the opening while it is fresh; the energy here is strongest when acted on promptly.

title: The Golden Mountain
summary: A stable and dignified sign. What has already been established is firm and likely to hold.

interpretation.general: This reading favors continuity, endurance, and the preservation of what matters most.
interpretation.caution: Arrival and completion may be delayed, but the underlying result remains favorable.

title: The Demon of the Heavenly Son
summary: A destructive sign of instability, desire-driven error, and serious obstruction.

interpretation.general: This reading warns that a promising situation may be scorched by impatience, ego, or destabilizing forces.
interpretation.caution: Health, travel, plans, and emotional judgment may all be compromised. Do not rush.

title: The Overflowing Jewelled Vessel
summary: A prosperous sign of increase, nourishment, and fortunate return.

interpretation.general: This reading suggests replenishment, gain, and welcome support. Resources and goodwill gather around you.
interpretation.caution: Some things may arrive a little later than hoped, but the direction remains positive.

title: The Scattered Mountain of Sand
summary: A sign of erosion and instability. What was built may break apart or lose cohesion.

interpretation.general: This reading points to gradual deterioration, loss of momentum, or plans being scattered by changing conditions.
interpretation.caution: Accumulated resources may diminish, and news or events may bring disappointment.

title: The Mansion of Gold
summary: A broad, stable sign of abundance, endurance, and future security.

interpretation.general: This reading favors lasting prosperity and strong foundations. It suggests ample support over time.
interpretation.caution: Some matters may move slowly. Illness may linger, even if the outcome is ultimately safe.

title: The Treasury of Jewels
summary: A strong sign of stored blessing, fulfilled wishes, and durable prosperity.

interpretation.general: This reading points to wealth, support, and long-range success emerging from a stable base.
interpretation.caution: Some results mature over time rather than instantly, but the long view is excellent.

title: Manjushri Appears
summary: A highly auspicious sign of wisdom, protection, and direct fulfillment.

interpretation.general: This reading carries a sense of blessing, authority, and aligned success. Support arrives through wisdom and right view.
interpretation.caution: Do not let doubt weaken a reading that is fundamentally strong.

title: The Endless Auspicious Knot
summary: A harmonious sign of beautiful unfolding, mutual support, and success through connection.

interpretation.general: This reading brings happiness, coherence, and favorable conditions in relationships, place, and decision-making.
interpretation.caution: The energy is excellent; the main task is simply to stay aligned and not create unnecessary complications.

title: The Golden Female Fish
summary: A sign of agility, luck, and graceful progress. Good fortune moves quickly and naturally.

interpretation.general: This reading supports successful movement, growing support, and healthy momentum in many areas of life.
interpretation.caution: The sign is broadly positive; results tend to unfold in good time rather than all at once.

title: The White Conch
summary: A sign of reputation, message, and beneficial news. Voice and communication are highlighted.

interpretation.general: This reading favors teaching, speech, announcements, and becoming known for something worthwhile.
interpretation.caution: Mental agitation may accompany illness even when the underlying danger is low.

title: The Golden Wheel
summary: A sign of prosperity, standing, and stable authority. Long-term success is supported.

interpretation.general: This reading points to dignity, order, and beneficial control over circumstances.
interpretation.caution: Recovery or completion may take a little longer than hoped, even though the outlook is good.

title: The Jeweled Banner of Victory
summary: A triumphant sign of excellence, fulfillment, stability, and victory in what you undertake.

interpretation.general: This is one of the strongest readings in the system. It indicates powerful accomplishment, protection, and results beyond expectation.
interpretation.caution: Success is high, but it should still be carried with humility and care.
